content:
After correcting to the cyclic start \([1,3,2,3]\), track directed adjacent pairs.  
Each operation replaces \((a,b)\) with \((a,a+b)\) and \((a+b,b)\). Starting from \((1,2)\) and \((2,1)\), every ordered coprime pair \((a,b)\) with \(a+b>2\) appears exactly once as an adjacent pair.

Thus each occurrence of a number \(m>2\) comes from an ordered coprime pair \((a,b)\) with \(a+b=m\). The number of such pairs is
\[
\#\{1\le a\le m-1:\gcd(a,m)=1\}=\varphi(m).
\]
So the count of \(m\) is \(\varphi(m)\).

Compute:
\[
\varphi(2015)=\varphi(5\cdot 13\cdot 31)
=2015\cdot \frac45\cdot \frac{12}{13}\cdot \frac{30}{31}=1440
\]
\[
\varphi(2016)=\varphi(2^5\cdot 3^2\cdot 7)
=2016\cdot \frac12\cdot \frac23\cdot \frac67=576
\]
Therefore the required sum is
\[
1440+576=2016.
\]

\[
\boxed{2016}
\]
